answer_1.quote: ...We conduct a comprehensive set of experiments using both open-and closed-source models to test their abilities in interpreting, contextualizing, and translating these proverbs... We evaluate Jawaher using both open-and closed-source state-of-the-art multilingual LLMs (mLLMs) to assess their abilities across our proposed tasks...
answer_1.outputs: English translations (idiomatic equivalents, literal translations) and generated explanations in Arabic and English

answer_2.quote: ...We use BLEURT and BERTScore to judge the quality of explanations and translations...

answer_3.quote: ...We use LangChain's 4 evaluation framework with string evaluator. We specifically customize the evaluation criteria to our own and use GPT-4o for evaluation...

answer_4.quote: ...Human evaluation is carried out by two expert annotators, both holding degrees in linguistics and translation studies... We develop evaluation criteria tailored to the nature of our tasks... Each annotator evaluated the models' performance using the developed metrics, by scoring each response on a scale from 1 to 5.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators scored model outputs on predefined criteria using a 1‑5 Likert scale.
